thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: high 5xx spike euc1-azf ingress reported by synthetic checks

maya (oncall): seeing it, alerts just hit my phone. investigating now. which stack?

ken (eng-sre): ingress-euc1 ClusterA -> envoy -> nlb -> alb chain, lots of upstream RSTs, 502/504s

maya (oncall): logs show Envoy upstream connection_reset. example: "upstream reset before response completed"

ken (eng-sre): kubectl -n ingress describe pods ingress-nginx-5f67: "Readiness probe failing, connections resetting"

ken (eng-sre): digging into ALB target health: hit list of targets flapping, TargetGroup tg-xyz shows unhealthy counts rising

tessa (eng-runtime): we're seeing increased keepalive timeouts on nlb side, provider reported high TLS handshake queue latency in azf

nate (network): confirmed provider side ANM report: ephemeral socket exhaustion in azf affecting NLB handlers, we can shift traffic to azd/aze

tessa (eng-runtime): can we apply weighted route53 change to move 60% -> azd? I'll prepare change

maya (oncall): customer impact: several checkout flows timing out, error rate ~8% for last 3m. ticket volume from top 10 customers increasing

lucy (support): FYI ACME storefront (cust-231) seeing a 30% failure rate on cart checkout, they've opened support case

sara (cust-success): I'll notify the affected accounts and escalate SLAs, need ETA on mitigation

ken (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) reduce route53 weight to shift healthy-region 2) increase ALB deregistration delay to shorten for quick ejection 3) set Envoy upstream keepalive lower

maya (oncall): ok ken/tessa take action, I'll coordinate comms and post updates

tessa (eng-runtime): executing change: aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift-azf-to-azd.json

tessa (eng-runtime): change submitted, change-id: C123456789, propagating :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Route53 change C123456789 status PENDING

ken (eng-sre): lowering ALB deregistration delay: aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/tg-xyz --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=10

ken (eng-sre): set Envoy cluster timeout to 20s and enable aggressive healthcheck retries

maya (oncall): handoff: I'm going to loop in nate for network followup and then hand to ken at 16:30 UTC, logging here

nate (network): provider confirmed mitigation window ~15m, they will restart some NLB frontends, we should observe decreased RSTs after that

tessa (eng-runtime): Route53 change now INSYNC, traffic shifting observed: euc1-azd inbound +55% while azf -60%

ken (eng-sre): metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 7.9% -> 1.2% over 6 minutes after shift, error logs show upstream reset events decline

lucy (support): ACME reports improved, cart success rate back to normal :thumbsup:

maya (oncall): continuing monitoring for 30m, if stable we'll close incident. documenting postmortem steps and owner assignments

sara (cust-success): sending customer update: root cause provider-side NLB socket exhaustion, mitigation: weighted routing to healthy AZ, follow-up scheduled

maya (oncall): handover to ken for postmortem. ken, please own RCA and remediation ticket

ken (eng-sre): taking postmortem, will include follow ups: add synthetic checks per az, automate weighted shift runbook, diag telemetry for tls queueing

maya (oncall): incident closed for paging, moving to monitoring phase :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved: paging cleared. duration ~22m. incident-id INC-2026-3470001234
